title: Cobblemon: Ultimate Adventure
description: A modpack to play Cobblemon with friends or alone, full of add-ons, performance and QoL mods.
body: Have you ever thought Cobblemon add-ons were a bit too much? **Me neither!** That's why I mixed around 40 of them in this modpack, alongside some performance and QoL mods and a few shaders. Whether you're into Singlepayer or Multiplayer, this modpack is for **you!** (and maybe your friends.) _So hop into the **incredible** Pokemon adventure awaiting you in Minecraft._
